items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems are increasingly being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern for Australian organisations. If your workplace uses these devices, they may need to meet new security standards — worth checking with your facilities or IT team. Separately, AI tools are creating new challenges for traditional security approaches, as automated systems can behave in ways that are difficult to monitor and control, even within well-protected networks.

No Australian-specific threats are reported today. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses smart energy devices on-site, ask whether they are on a separate, secured network away from your main systems.

featured.title: Australia's home batteries are now a cybersecurity compliance isue
featured.summary: Millions of rooftop batteries are now subject to mandatory cyber standards as Canberra widens scrutiny of grid-connected home devices.
